generation.scope: All ordered three-commutator lifts are reconstructed for every reduced cubic determinant, including a tangent conic, a triangle and three concurrent lines. The regular-generator part uses explicit six-space adjugates and negative doubling on the generalized Jacobian, and every scalar-plus-rank-one generator is recovered by the compression-pair strata. The generic balanced tangent conic fiber has two isolated points and two affine lines; tangency is exactly the collision of the two points at infinity of the semisimple fiber conic in the stated open coordinates.

open_mathematics: Investigate nonreduced nonzero commutator determinants starting with a triple line: classify nilpotent 3-by-3 auxiliary pencils, including the nontriangular pencil, and determine which produce full symmetrizers. Use the resulting structure for marked-window coverage and pursue all-degree regularity and the remaining unmarked windows.
